description: Ultra-Plush 500 GSM Fabric - Premium 500 GSM microfiber with ultra-dense fibers ensures superior absorbency and plush feel. Perfect for car and bike detailing, leaving surfaces scratch-free, swirl-free, and shiny after every use. Double-Sided, Scratch-Free Design - Unique dual-sided construction with suede edging provides safe cleaning for delicate surfaces. One side wipes off dirt and grime, while the other polishes to a streak-free, spotless finish. Super Absorbent & Quick Drying Absorbs up to 3–4 times its weight in water, making it ideal for drying after a wash. Quick-drying fibers prevent foul odor, ensuring long-lasting freshness and convenient everyday use. Lint-Free & Streak-Free Finish Engineered with fine microfiber technology for a spotless clean. Leaves no lint, streaks, or watermarks on glass, paint, chrome, or interior surfaces, delivering a showroom-like finish every time. Durable & Multi-Purpose Utility Washable and reusable up to hundreds of times without losing softness or performance. Ideal for cars, bikes, windows, kitchen, and household cleaning, making it a versatile all-in-one solution.
